crossRefs.note: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

parallels.note: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

translations.web: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
translations.bsb: You have made my enemies retreat before me; I destroyed those who hated me.
translations.kjv: Thou hast also given me the necks of mine enemies; that I might destroy them that hate
translations.asv: Thou hast also made mine enemies turn their backs unto me, That I might cut off them that hate me.
